findings: For an explicit strictly stable full-width septic box, seven positive actual atoms annihilate the REAL span of the four parity endpoints plus the first two midpoint derivatives, excluding any common numerator in that six-dimensional span. A known unrestricted numerator and all stability/pairing conditions were independently replayed. The obstruction and fixed positive numerator persist on an explicit 14-dimensional endpoint neighborhood.

The bound is sharp for this box and the same endpoint neighborhood: an exact moving common numerator in the span of the same four endpoints plus the first THREE midpoint derivatives was independently reconstructed and checked, with uniform perturbation control. The separately pinned leading-coefficient erratum explains that the two odd-generator weights sum exactly to one.

An opposite-sign 6x6 boundary determinant criterion gives a nonempty open set of nine-parameter five-contact boundary shapes whose near-boundary radial stable boxes have no common numerator in their six-generator real span; unrestricted existence is not claimed for all shapes.

A full basis built from those six directions plus D^3m,D^4m has two independent exact positive-atom half-plane constraints, both with negative quotient coordinates. These do not rule out all numerators and the known numerator is feasible.

Thirty further ultrawide oscillatory-centered boxes received individual exact common numerators; independent replay checked 840 strict Hurwitz minors and 16928 strict pairing Bernstein coefficients. This is bounded finite evidence only.
remaining_gap: No actual stable box with a strict all-numerator negative certificate, and no universal positive synthesis theorem, have been established. The six-dimensional and quotient obstructions are restricted, and the seven-dimensional positive witness proves this particular restricted path cannot simply extend.
next_action: Seek a distinct representation or actual-box strict certificate beyond the sharp six-dimensional span barrier.
